relations.text: 個別化ネオアンチゲン療法の共同開発・商業化で提携契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Merck has a collaboration and license agreement with Moderna on an individualized neoantigen therapy

source.label: Merck & Co., Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2022, Merck exercised its option to jointly develop and commercialize intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), an investigational individualized neoantigen therapy, pursuant to the terms of an existing collaboration and license agreement with Moderna, Inc. (Moderna).

relations.text: sGC調節薬の販売と開発で世界的な共同開発を行う

source.label: Merck & Co., Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2014, the Company entered into a worldwide clinical development collaboration with Bayer AG (Bayer) to market and develop soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) modulators including Bayer’s Adempas (riociguat) and Verquvo (vericiguat).
